issues.display_title: Issue #1825: Support Multi-Level Nested Menu Hierarchy in Template Match API (V2)
issues.main_description_html:
Ref: #1820

Background

In #1820, multi-level menu hierarchies (sub > sub > sub) were flattened into a 1D sub array in GET /templates/menu/match (V1) to prevent legacy frontend crashes. A V2 endpoint is required to natively return the fully recursive nested tree structure.

Scope & Tasks

  1. New Route: Add GET /v2/templates/menu/match.
  2. Recursive Parser: Use OverlaysClass::getMenuV2() to build multi-level nested structures (name, pano_id, recursive sub_menus).
  3. Recursive Validation: Recursively validate panorama IDs against tablePanoramas while preserving structural containers (pano_id = 0).
  4. Backward Compatibility: Ensure the V1 endpoint remains unchanged with its 1D flattened structure.

Acceptance Criteria

  • GET /v2/templates/menu/match returns fully nested menu trees.
  • Language fallback remains safe ($lang -> 'en' -> '').
  • V1 endpoint continues returning 1D flattened structures.
  • Unit/feature tests added.

Implementation & Verification Result

1. New V2 Endpoint

  • Route: GET /v2/templates/menu/match
  • Controller & Action: App\Http\Controllers\User\TemplateController@getTemplateMatchV2 -> App\Http\Controllers\User\Template\Actions\GetMatchV2
  • Output Schema: 
    {
  "statusCode": 200,
  "data": {
    "messages": "Data retrieved",
    "template_type": "personal",
    "template_name": "Festival",
    "menu": [
      {
        "name": "STAFF",
        "pano_id": 0,
        "sub_menus": [
          {
            "name": "Direction",
            "pano_id": 45562802,
            "sub_menus": []
          },
          {
            "name": "MEDIAS",
            "pano_id": 0,
            "sub_menus": [
              {
                "name": "Espace Presse / Médias",
                "pano_id": 45562883,
                "sub_menus": []
              }
            ]
          }
        ]
      }
    ],
    "gallery": []
  }
}
  • Encryption & Dual-Mode: Supports unencrypted output when ec: false header is passed; defaults to standard encrypted envelope (encryptResult).

2. Artifacts & Commits

  • Code implementation: Commit 4746894e4 (feat(templates): support multi-level nested menu hierarchy in template match api v2 (#1825))
  • API Documentation: Commit 038a2a711 (docs/v2/templates/get-template-menu-match-v2.md)
  • API Collection: api-collection/GoThru API NEW/User/Templates/Menu Match V2.yml

3. Automated & Live Verification

  • tests/Class/OverlaysGetMenuV2Test.php: 3 tests, 16 assertions passed (multi-level nesting, fallback to en, empty pano payload handling).
  • tests/Actions/Templates/GetMatchV2ActionTest.php: 2 tests, 4 assertions passed (validation guards on missing fid and Authorization token).
  • Live verification against tour f54g7nNB: successfully validated deep 3-level tree retrieval without data loss.
